description: Insulation contractor in Newark, CA for attic, spray foam and crawl space work, 14 miles south of our San Leandro base. Request a free inspection.
intro: East Bay Insulation serves Newark from our San Leandro base, 14 miles north. The drive is short and predictable, so inspections, estimates and follow-up visits fit neatly into the same week.

paragraphs: Homes in Newark range from older tracts to newer subdivisions, and the insulation plan has to match the house. We start every Newark job with a free inspection of the attic, the crawl space and the walls.
Whatever we find, you get a written estimate before any work begins, and the same crew handles the job from inspection to completion.

bullets: Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers
Spray foam for attics and rim joists

faqs.q: How far is Newark from your base?
faqs.a: About 14 miles south of San Leandro. Most inspections are scheduled within the week.

faqs.q: Do you serve newer homes too?
faqs.a: Yes. Newer homes get the same free inspection and written estimate, and the plan is based on what the house actually has.
The attic, crawl space and walls. We explain what is there, what it would take to improve it, and the estimate is written and fixed.
